crop.notes: Clipping is the whole Sporting Notes column plus baseball box scores and standings; only the third note (three lines) is about Allen

ocr.notes: Allen notice partly garbled: 'Free concert' dropped and 'only' misread; rest of column is box-score noise

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at No. 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, October 15, 1892, page 7

facts.fact: Allen, billed as retired champion pugilist of the world, kept a place at No. 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening
